Hello, this is my project called “MotionCore”. Its a servo tester. But not your ordenairy servo tester, it can animate, test, and position your servo’s, right now it is 1 servo, if i can order more parts I want to order a pca9685 so it can test 16 servo’s.

My name is Thijs Altenburg and im 15 years old. I want to be an engineer when im older. I want to create animatronics and shows, so I want to build, record music and program animatronics! My Last name is Altenburg, so I want to have a company named “Altentronics” so I put the name in te tester.
